title: VIN-specific safety-campaign completion across custody changes
material_difference: Safety campaign eligibility and completion are an OEM-triggered job, unlike optional paid preventive service or generic reminder engagement.
existing_baseline: Toyota already supplies VIN lookup, campaign FAQs, helpline and dealer booking; no missing Auto2000 capability is demonstrated.
possible_unresolved_difference: If evidence later shows owners or buyers cannot establish campaign completion across custody/branch changes, make that completion evidence useful within existing authorized channels.
counterevidence: The OEM lookup and official-dealer process may already resolve the task fully.
decision_rights: OEM controls affected VINs/remedy; branch completes authorized work; current owner consents and attends.
benefit_hypothesis: Avoid missed eligible safety action and unresolved buyer uncertainty; no incident reduction, revenue or completion uplift estimated.
commercial_mechanism: Any authorized reimbursement or downstream trust effect is unverified; do not justify through paid upsell.
excluded_customers: Hard-to-reach current owners, distant/immobilized vehicles, and VINs not in a campaign require distinct handling.
failure_condition: Current process already provides usable completion evidence, or no meaningful unresolved completion job exists.
status: Separate research candidate, not appended to frozen 27 menu; no implementation or winner
